task: Deepen (flagship 5): einvoice-preflight, Poland FA(3): KSeF's receipt checks beyond the XSD
errors: Eval regexes first misread the Ministry's C# (third range clause not matched, '% 11' from IsValidNip taken as the internal-id modulus); caught because the run reported mismatches, fixed before landing.
First draft of the mojibake explanation said Windows-1250; U+009B actually comes from ISO-8859-2 (cp1250 maps 0x9B to U+203A). Corrected in code, eval doc, test and post before commit.

doc_friction.issue: The page and its test asserted 'does not run the full FA(3) XSD' for three weeks after the XSD gate shipped (2026-10-25); the page test pinned the stale claim, so it never failed.
Filled IDWew placeholders with 5260250274-12345, which fails the Ministry's own internal-id check digit; any rule on that digit looked like a false positive on official templates.

Installing the .NET SDK via dotnet-install.sh into the scratchpad (to run the Ministry's MIT validator differentially) was refused by the auto-mode classifier; no doc says which toolchain installs are allowed, so the differential reads the C# source by pattern instead.
